items.text: Stock sync inapoteza rows tukirudi online. Angalia src/sync/queue.rs, nadhani ni ile retry.

Tatizo liko kwenye `drain()`: it emptied the whole queue before the server acknowledged anything.

Sasa row inatoka kwenye queue baada ya ack tu, and a reconnect resends what is left.
Forked from here. The files in duka-pos are as they are now.

note: Notices the host marks carry their word, so a client can put Undo on a rewind's (while the thread can undo): a fork's "forked" after its copied turn, a later rewind's "rewound" in the cut turn's place. A word the client doesn't know reads as absent; a plain notice has none.
